args.title: Board size and mine count fixed for the session

args.title: New session starts in Ready state

args.title: Mines placed after first reveal
args.description: Mines are not placed when the game starts. They are placed at random on the first reveal, and that reveal moves the session to In progress.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state with no mines placed When the player reveals a hidden cell for the first time Then mines are placed at random and the session status becomes in-progress

args.title: First revealed cell is never a mine
args.description: The cell revealed first is excluded from mine placement, so the first reveal can never trigger a loss.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals cell (r, c) first Then cell (r, c) has has_mine false

args.title: Exact mine count placed
args.description: Exactly the difficulty's mine count is placed on the board, on distinct cells.
args.given_when_then: Given a session with mine_count M is placed after the first reveal Then exactly M cells have has_mine true

args.title: Adjacency count of a safe cell
args.description: A safe cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mines among its eight neighbours.
args.given_when_then: Given a safe cell with exactly K mines among its eight neighbours When mines are placed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is K, where 0 <= K <= 8

args.title: Edge and corner cells count only existing neighbours
args.description: For edge and corner cells, only neighbours that exist on the board are counted.
args.given_when_then: Given a corner cell with 2 neighbours that are mines and 1 neighbour that is safe When adjacency is computed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is 2

args.title: Reveal a hidden unflagged cell
args.description: The player may reveal a hidden cell that is not flagged. The cell becomes revealed.
args.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged cell in a session in progress When the player reveals the cell Then the cell state becomes revealed

args.title: Flagged cell cannot be revealed
args.description: A flagged cell must be unflagged before it can be revealed. A reveal on a flagged cell is ignored.
args.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell Then the cell state remains flagged and nothing else changes

args.title: Revealed cell cannot be revealed again
args.description: Revealed is a terminal cell state. Revealing an already revealed cell is ignored.
args.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell again Then the cell state remains revealed and the timer is unaffected

args.title: Revealing a mine loses the game
args.description: Revealing a mine ends the session as lost and stops the timer.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in progress and a hidden unflagged cell with has_mine true When the player reveals the cell Then the session status becomes lost and ended_at is recorded

args.title: Zero-count reveal spreads to neighbours
args.description: Revealing a safe cell with adjacency count zero also reveals all of its neighbours.
args.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the player reveals the cell Then all eight neighbours that exist become revealed

args.title: Spread repeats through connected zeros and stops at numbers
args.description: The spread continues through every connected zero-count cell. Numbered cells are revealed but do not spread further.
args.given_when_then: Given a connected region of zero-count cells bordered by numbered cells When a zero-count cell in the region is revealed Then every cell in the region and its bordering numbered cells are revealed, and the numbered cells do not reveal their own neighbours

args.title: Spread skips flagged cells
args.description: A flagged cell cannot be revealed, so the spread leaves flagged cells hidden.
args.given_when_then: Given a zero-count cell next to a flagged cell When the zero-count cell is revealed Then the flagged cell remains flagged

args.title: Toggle a flag on a hidden cell
args.description: The player toggles a flag on a hidden cell. Flagging changes hidden to flagged and unflagging changes flagged back to hidden.
args.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell When the player toggles the flag Then the cell state becomes flagged, and toggling again returns the cell state to hidden

args.title: Revealed cell cannot be flagged

args.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player toggles a flag on the cell Then the cell state remains revealed and the flag count is unchanged

args.title: Flags do not reveal cells

args.title: Flagging before first reveal keeps session in Ready

args.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player flags a hidden cell Then the session status remains ready and elapsed_seconds stays 0

args.title: Win when every safe cell is revealed
args.description: The game is won when all safe cells are revealed. Mines remain hidden or flagged and do not block the win.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where the last hidden safe cell is revealed When the reveal completes Then the session status becomes won and ended_at is recorded

args.title: Win does not require flags
args.description: A win depends only on revealed safe cells. Flags are not checked.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where all safe cells are revealed and no mine cell is flagged When the last safe cell is revealed Then the session status becomes won

args.title: Loss exposes all mines
args.description: When the game is lost, every mine on the board is exposed to the player.
args.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been lost When the board is finalised Then every cell with has_mine true is exposed to the player

args.title: Abandon a game at any time
args.description: The player may abandon an unfinished game at any time to start a new board at the same difficulty. An abandoned game has no result.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready or in progress When the player abandons the game Then the session status becomes abandoned with no win or loss result and a new board is created at the same difficulty

args.title: Timer starts at first reveal
args.description: The elapsed timer starts when the first cell is revealed, not when the game is created or when a flag is placed.
args.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals the first cell Then started_at is recorded and the timer begins counting

args.title: Timer stops on win or loss
args.description: The timer stops when the game is won or lost and does not advance afterwards.
args.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been won or lost with elapsed_seconds 120 When time passes Then elapsed_seconds remains 120

args.title: New game returns to Ready
args.description: Starting a new game resets all cells to hidden, clears mines and flags, resets the timer and returns the session to Ready.
args.given_when_then: Given a session that is won, lost or abandoned When the player starts a new game Then the status is ready, all cells are hidden, flag_count is 0 and elapsed_seconds is 0

args.title: Session status transitions
args.description: The session moves Ready to In progress on first reveal, then to Won or Lost. Won and Lost are terminal, and only a new game returns the session to Ready.
args.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When any action other than starting a new game is attempted Then the status remains won or lost

args.title: Cell state transitions
args.description: A cell moves Hidden to Revealed (terminal), and between Hidden and Flagged. A flagged cell cannot move directly to Revealed.
args.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When a reveal is attempted Then the cell does not move to revealed, and given a revealed cell When any flag action is attempted Then the cell does not move to flagged

args.title: Mine counter equals mines minus flags
args.description: The mine counter shown to the player is the mine count minus the number of flags placed.
args.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 3 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows 7

args.title: Mine counter may go negative
args.description: The mine counter is not clamped. It goes negative when the player places more flags than there are mines.
args.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 12 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows -2

args.title: Board actions after game end are ignored
args.description: After a game is won, lost or abandoned, reveal and flag actions are ignored. They change no cell state and do not affect the timer.
args.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When the player reveals or flags any cell Then no cell state changes and elapsed_seconds is unchanged

actions.name: start_new_game
actions.description: Replaces the board with a new hidden board for the chosen difficulty: status becomes ready, every cell is hidden with no mine placed, flag_count and elapsed_seconds become 0, and started_at and ended_at are cleared. Allowed from any status, including in_progress, won, lost and abandoned; rows, columns and mine_count must match the chosen difficulty.

actions.name: reveal_cell
actions.description: Reveals the hidden, unflagged cell at row and column. On the first reveal of a ready session, mines are placed at random avoiding that cell, adjacent_mine_count is computed for every cell, status becomes in_progress and started_at is recorded. Revealing a mine sets status to lost and records ended_at; revealing a zero-count cell also reveals its neighbours repeatedly through connected zeros, stopping at numbered cells and leaving flagged cells flagged; when every safe cell is revealed status becomes won and ended_at is recorded. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden unflagged cell.

actions.name: toggle_flag
actions.description: Toggles the flag on the cell at row and column: a hidden cell becomes flagged and flag_count rises by one, and a flagged cell becomes hidden and flag_count falls by one. It reveals nothing and does not start the timer. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress on a hidden or flagged cell.

actions.name: abandon_game
actions.description: Ends the current game with no result: status becomes abandoned, ended_at is recorded and elapsed_seconds stops at its current value. Allowed only while status is ready or in_progress; the player then starts a new board at the same difficulty.

starting_states.description: status is ready, flag_count is 0, elapsed_seconds is 0, started_at and ended_at are null, rows, columns and mine_count are set from the chosen difficulty, and cells holds rows times columns records each with row and column set to its position, state hidden, has_mine false and adjacent_mine_count 0; no mines are placed until the first reveal.

values.meaning: new game with no reveal yet; no mines placed and the timer not started
after the first reveal and until the game is won, lost or abandoned; the timer is running
terminal: every safe cell has been revealed without revealing a mine
terminal: a mine was revealed; all mines are exposed on screen
terminal: the player ended the game early; no win or loss result
the cell is covered and unflagged; it can be revealed or flagged
terminal for the cell: the cell is open and shows its adjacent_mine_count or blank
the player has marked the cell as a suspected mine; it cannot be revealed until unflagged

rejections.raised_when: the action is refused by the rules: revealing a flagged or revealed cell, flagging a revealed cell, any reveal or flag after the game is won, lost or abandoned, or abandoning a game that is not ready or in_progress; no cell state or timer changes

import pytest

from src.domain.game_session import GameSession

EXPERT_ROWS = 16
EXPERT_COLUMNS = 30
EXPERT_MINES = 99

# 99 consecutive row-major indices (380..478). Index 479 is cell (15, 29),
# which stays safe. Its three neighbours (14, 28), (14, 29) and (15, 28)
# are mines, so it is a numbered cell with count 3 and does not spread.
MINE_INDICES = range(380, 479)


def _mine_positions():
    return {
        (index // EXPERT_COLUMNS, index % EXPERT_COLUMNS)
        for index in MINE_INDICES
    }


def _adjacent_count(mines, row, column):
    count = 0
    for d_row in (-1, 0, 1):
        for d_col in (-1, 0, 1):
            if (d_row, d_col) == (0, 0):
                continue
            if (row + d_row, column + d_col) in mines:
                count += 1
    return count


def _expert_session_in_progress():
    session = GameSession(
        id="session-expert",
        difficulty_id="expert",
        rows=EXPERT_ROWS,
        columns=EXPERT_COLUMNS,
        mine_count=EXPERT_MINES,
    )
    session.status = "in_progress"
    session.started_at = "2024-03-01T10:00:00"
    mines = _mine_positions()
    for cell in session.cells:
        position = (cell["row"], cell["column"])
        cell["has_mine"] = position in mines
        cell["adjacent_mine_count"] = _adjacent_count(
            mines, cell["row"], cell["column"]
        )
    return session


def _cell_at(session, row, column):
    return next(
        cell
        for cell in session.cells
        if cell["row"] == row and cell["column"] == column
    )


def _assert_expert_dimensions(session):
    assert session.rows == 16
    assert session.columns == 30
    assert session.mine_count == 99


def test_reveal_on_last_cell_keeps_expert_dimensions():
    session = _expert_session_in_progress()

    session.reveal_cell(row=15, column=29)

    # (15, 29) is inside the 16x30 board, hidden, unflagged and safe
    # (index 479 is not a mine), so the reveal is allowed. Its count is 3
    # from the mines at (14,28), (14,29) and (15,28), so nothing spreads and
    # the board is not won. The cell itself becomes revealed.
    assert _cell_at(session, 15, 29)["state"] == "revealed"
    # The reveal does not touch the board size or the mine count, so they
    # still read 16, 30 and 99.
    _assert_expert_dimensions(session)


def test_toggle_flag_on_last_cell_keeps_expert_dimensions():
    session = _expert_session_in_progress()

    session.toggle_flag(row=15, column=29)

    # (15, 29) is hidden and inside the board, so the flag is placed:
    # the cell becomes flagged and flag_count goes from 0 to 1. Nothing else
    # about the board changes.
    assert _cell_at(session, 15, 29)["state"] == "flagged"
    assert session.flag_count == 1
    # The flag does not change the board size or the mine count.
    _assert_expert_dimensions(session)


def test_abandon_game_keeps_expert_dimensions():
    session = _expert_session_in_progress()

    session.abandon_game()

    # The session is in_progress, which is a status abandon_game accepts,
    # so the game ends as abandoned with no win or loss result.
    assert session.status == "abandoned"
    # Ending the game does not change the board size or the mine count.
    _assert_expert_dimensions(session)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column", [(16, 29), (15, 30)])
def test_reveal_beyond_expert_board_is_refused_and_dimensions_stay(row, column):
    session = _expert_session_in_progress()

    # Only one coordinate is moved past the last valid index (15 for rows,
    # 29 for columns). Row 16 or column 30 lies outside the 16x30 board,
    # so the reveal is refused with CellOutOfBoundsError.
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        session.reveal_cell(row=row, column=column)
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "CellOutOfBoundsError"

    # The refused action leaves the board size and the mine count unchanged.
    _assert_expert_dimensions(session)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column", [(16, 29), (15, 30)])
def test_toggle_flag_beyond_expert_board_is_refused_and_dimensions_stay(row, column):
    session = _expert_session_in_progress()

    # Only one coordinate is moved past the last valid index. The flag
    # placement is refused with CellOutOfBoundsError because the cell lies
    # outside the 16x30 board.
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        session.toggle_flag(row=row, column=column)
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "CellOutOfBoundsError"

    # The refused action leaves the board size and the mine count unchanged.
    _assert_expert_dimensions(session)

EXPERT_ROWS = 16
EXPERT_COLUMNS = 30
EXPERT_MINES = 99

# 99 consecutive row-major indices (380..478). Index 479 is cell (15, 29),

# are mines, so it is a numbered cell with count 3 and does not spread.
MINE_INDICES = range(380, 479)


def _mine_positions():
    return {
        (index // EXPERT_COLUMNS, index % EXPERT_COLUMNS)
        for index in MINE_INDICES
    }


def _adjacent_count(mines, row, column):
    count = 0
    for d_row in (-1, 0, 1):
        for d_col in (-1, 0, 1):
            if (d_row, d_col) == (0, 0):
                continue
            if (row + d_row, column + d_col) in mines:
                count += 1
    return count


def _expert_session_in_progress():
    session = GameSession(
        id="session-expert",
        difficulty_id="expert",
        rows=EXPERT_ROWS,
        columns=EXPERT_COLUMNS,
        mine_count=EXPERT_MINES,
    )
    session.status = "in_progress"
    session.started_at = "2024-03-01T10:00:00"
    mines = _mine_positions()
    for cell in session.cells:
        position = (cell["row"], cell["column"])
        cell["has_mine"] = position in mines
        cell["adjacent_mine_count"] = _adjacent_count(
            mines, cell["row"], cell["column"]
        )
    return session


def _cell_at(session, row, column):
    return next(
        cell
        for cell in session.cells
        if cell["row"] == row and cell["column"] == column
    )

    # the board is not won. The cell itself becomes revealed.

from src.domain.game_session import GameSession


ROWS = 9
COLUMNS = 9
MINE_COUNT = 10
TARGET_ROW = 4
TARGET_COLUMN = 4


def build_cells(rows, columns):
    """One hidden, mine-free record for every position, as a new session holds them."""
    return [
        {
            "id": f"{r}-{c}",
            "row": r,
            "column": c,
            "has_mine": False,
            "adjacent_mine_count": 0,
            "state": "hidden",
        }
        for r in range(rows)
        for c in range(columns)
    ]


def make_session(status):
    """Beginner-sized session with a hidden board, in the given status.

    Timestamps are fixed ISO strings. elapsed_seconds is 120 so that any
    accidental timer change would be visible.
    """
    session = GameSession(
        id="session-1",
        difficulty_id="beginner",
        rows=ROWS,
        columns=COLUMNS,
        mine_count=MINE_COUNT,
    )
    session.cells = build_cells(ROWS, COLUMNS)
    session.status = status
    session.flag_count = 0
    session.elapsed_seconds = 120
    session.started_at = "2024-01-01T10:00:00"
    if status in ("won", "lost"):
        session.ended_at = "2024-01-01T10:02:00"
    else:
        session.ended_at = None
    return session


def cell_at(session, row, column):
    for cell in session.cells:
        if cell["row"] == row and cell["column"] == column:
            return cell
    raise AssertionError(f"no cell at ({row}, {column})")


def call_action(session, action):
    if action == "reveal_cell":
        session.reveal_cell(row=TARGET_ROW, column=TARGET_COLUMN)
    elif action == "toggle_flag":
        session.toggle_flag(row=TARGET_ROW, column=TARGET_COLUMN)
    elif action == "abandon_game":
        session.abandon_game()
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"unknown action {action}")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ended_status", ["won", "lost"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["reveal_cell", "toggle_flag", "abandon_game"])
def test_actions_other_than_new_game_are_refused_and_status_remains_terminal(ended_status, action):
    session = make_session(ended_status)
    ended_at_before = session.ended_at

    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        call_action(session, action)

    # Rules: reveal and flag are allowed only while ready or in_progress, and
    # abandon is allowed only while ready or in_progress. The status is terminal,
    # so every one of these three actions is refused with ActionNotAllowedError.
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "ActionNotAllowedError"

    # The status stays at the terminal value it had before the attempt.
    assert session.status == ended_status

    # The refused action changed nothing else: the target cell is still hidden
    # (a reveal or flag would otherwise have changed it), no flag was added,
    # the end time is unchanged, and the elapsed timer is still 120.
    assert cell_at(session, TARGET_ROW, TARGET_COLUMN)["state"] == "hidden"
    assert session.flag_count == 0
    assert session.ended_at == ended_at_before

    # cell, identical elapsed time, only the status differs. The status is
    # in_progress, which allows toggle_flag on a hidden cell. The flag is placed,
    # so the refusal above is decided by the terminal status alone.
    session = make_session("in_progress")

    session.toggle_flag(row=TARGET_ROW, column=TARGET_COLUMN)

    # The hidden target cell becomes flagged, and flag_count rises from 0 to 1.
    assert cell_at(session, TARGET_ROW, TARGET_COLUMN)["state"] == "flagged"
    assert session.flag_count == 1
    # Flagging does not end the game or change the timer.
    assert session.status == "in_progress"
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 120

    # terminal status alone.

    assert session.status == "abandoned"
    assert session.ended_at is not None
    # elapsed_seconds stops at its current value of 120.
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == 120

                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns and (nr, nc) in mines:
                    count += 1
        cell["adjacent_mine_count"] = count

    )

        rows=ROWS,
        columns=COLUMNS,

import pytest

from src.domain.game_session import GameSession

TARGET_ROW = 4
TARGET_COLUMN = 4
STARTED_AT = "2024-01-01T10:00:00"
ENDED_AT = "2024-01-01T10:02:00"
ELAPSED_AT_END = 120


def _make_finished_board(status: str) -> GameSession:
    """Beginner-sized 9x9 board with 10 mines, arranged as a finished game.

    Every cell is revealed and safe except the target cell (4, 4), which is a
    hidden mine. This is consistent with a won game (all safe cells open, the
    mine still covered) and with a lost game (the status is what matters here).
    """
    session = GameSession(
        id="game-1",
        difficulty_id="beginner",
        rows=9,
        columns=9,
        mine_count=10,
    )
    cells = []
    for row in range(9):
        for column in range(9):
            if row == TARGET_ROW and column == TARGET_COLUMN:
                state, has_mine = "hidden", True
            else:
                state, has_mine = "revealed", False
            cells.append(
                {
                    "id": f"cell-{row}-{column}",
                    "row": row,
                    "column": column,
                    "has_mine": has_mine,
                    "adjacent_mine_count": 0,
                    "state": state,
                }
            )
    session.cells = cells
    session.status = status
    session.flag_count = 0
    session.elapsed_seconds = ELAPSED_AT_END
    session.started_at = STARTED_AT
    session.ended_at = ENDED_AT
    return session


def _cell_snapshot(session: GameSession):
    return [dict(cell) for cell in session.cells]


def _reveal(session: GameSession):
    return session.reveal_cell(row=TARGET_ROW, column=TARGET_COLUMN)


def _toggle_flag(session: GameSession):
    return session.toggle_flag(row=TARGET_ROW, column=TARGET_COLUMN)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["won", "lost"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "action",
    [_reveal, _toggle_flag],
    ids=["reveal_cell", "toggle_flag"],
)
def test_board_action_after_game_end_is_refused_and_changes_nothing(status, action):
    # Given a finished game (won or lost) on a 9x9 board with 10 mines.
    # The target cell (4, 4) is hidden and holds a mine, so it is a legal
    # target for both reveal and flag if the status did not block it.
    # Every other cell is revealed and safe; flag_count is 0; the timer
    # stands at 120 seconds; ended_at is recorded.
    session = _make_finished_board(status)
    cells_before = _cell_snapshot(session)

    # When the player reveals or flags the target cell.
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info:
        action(session)

    # Then the action is refused by the rules.
    assert type(exc_info.value).__name__ == "ActionNotAllowedError"

    # And no cell state changed: the target is still hidden because the
    # game is over, and every other cell is still revealed.
    assert _cell_snapshot(session) == cells_before

    # And the timer is unchanged: it stays at 120 seconds.
    assert session.elapsed_seconds == ELAPSED_AT_END

    # And the session status is still the terminal status it was.
    assert session.status == status

    # Given the same 9x9 board, arranged as in progress instead of finished.
    # The target cell (4, 4) is hidden and unflagged, and flag_count is 0.
    # Nothing else blocks a flag: the status is in_progress and the cell is
    # hidden, which are the rules for toggling a flag.
    session = _make_finished_board("in_progress")
    session.ended_at = None
    session.elapsed_seconds = ELAPSED_AT_END

    # When the player flags the target cell.
    _toggle_flag(session)

    # Then the target cell becomes flagged, because a hidden cell in an
    # in-progress game can be flagged.
    target = next(
        cell
        for cell in session.cells
        if cell["row"] == TARGET_ROW and cell["column"] == TARGET_COLUMN
    )
    assert target["state"] == "flagged"

    # And flag_count rises from 0 to 1, because one cell has been flagged.
    assert session.flag_count == 1

    # And the status is still in_progress, because flagging does not end
    # the game.
    assert session.status == "in_progress"
